tasks.task: Integrate explicit sunlight visibility into IRIS and run matched ablations
tasks.finding: reduced EXP0019's sun-attributable normalized-gap contamination from +18.4/+14.0pp to +1.7/+1.6pp at matched 200-step budget (~11x), now same order of magnitude as SGS-Intrinsic's -0.43/-1.20pp (EXP0024), though still 1.5-4x larger in absolute value
tasks.required_fix: adding the explicit sun term alone was insufficient/actively harmful (two failed parameterizations made contamination 3x WORSE than vanilla IRIS); only worked once a within-segment albedo-consistency regularizer was added alongside it, since kd/albedo had zero spatial regularization in IRIS's has_part branch and had no reason to prefer the new low-DOF term
limitations: absolute albedo accuracy degraded (saturated/clipped at 200 steps)
not stable across step counts: 1000-step run regresses to +6.6/+5.4pp
sun direction is oracle (generator ground truth), not Mode B or ephemeris-recovered
does not yet touch emitter extraction/classification stage
